# Don't Spiral

> Your 24/7 safe space when relationship anxiety hits. AI-powered support for anxious attachment, ROCD, jealousy, overthinking, and breakup anxiety. Not therapy — a friend who gets it.

## About

Don't Spiral is a mobile app (iOS and Android) that acts as an AI relationship-anxiety
coach. It remembers your story and helps you find clarity before you react — available
around the clock, built for the acute moment: the 2am spiral, the post-fight shakes,
the text you're about to regret. It helps with:

- Anxious attachment and fear of abandonment
- Relationship anxiety and constant worry about your partner
- ROCD (Relationship OCD) — intrusive doubts about love and commitment
- Jealousy, insecurity, and reassurance-seeking
- Overthinking every text, conversation, and interaction
- Breakup anxiety and codependency patterns

It draws on techniques from CBT and Exposure Response Prevention (ERP) and helps build
secure attachment habits. It is not therapy and not a replacement for professional help.
